verdict.rationale: A live probe returns HTTP 200 for llms.txt on ReadMe's own ReadMe-hosted docs, and it advertises appending .md to any page URL for markdown. Section-level llms.txt URLs throughout the docs suggest the platform generates these files automatically, and the AI Discoverability feature scores projects against the Agent-Friendly Docs spec. missing for 10: evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), explicit first-party documentation that customer hubs serve llms.txt automatically by default, independent corroboration.
